company.shortDescription: KIB is a bank that provides financial, investment, banking, and internet banking services.
company.description: KIB is a bank that offers financial and banking services. Their service categories include finance, investments, and cards. They provide credit and debit cards. Their finance services include medical financing, consumer goods, building materials, cars, indebtedness transfer, and partial service. They also provide internet banking services.
